title: Sparkly alarm clock
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- sparkles -->
  <g fill="#ffe066">
    <!-- top-left sparkle -->
    <path d="M18 16 L20 24 L28 26 L20 28 L18 36 L16 28 L8 26 L16 24 Z"/>
    <!-- top-right sparkle -->
    <path d="M82 12 L84 19 L91 21 L84 23 L82 30 L80 23 L73 21 L80 19 Z"/>
    <!-- bottom-left sparkle -->
    <path d="M12 68 L14 74 L20 76 L14 78 L12 84 L10 78 L4 76 L10 74 Z"/>
    <!-- bottom-right sparkle -->
    <path d="M88 64 L90 70 L96 72 L90 74 L88 80 L86 74 L80 72 L86 70 Z"/>
    <!-- small sparkles -->
    <path d="M34 8 L35 11 L38 12 L35 13 L34 16 L33 13 L30 12 L33 11 Z"/>
    <path d="M66 88 L67 91 L70 92 L67 93 L66 96 L65 93 L62 92 L65 91 Z"/>
  </g>

  <!-- bells -->
  <circle cx="22" cy="28" r="11" fill="#ffd166"/>
  <circle cx="22" cy="28" r="7" fill="#f4a300"/>
  <circle cx="78" cy="28" r="11" fill="#ffd166"/>
  <circle cx="78" cy="28" r="7" fill="#f4a300"/>
  <rect x="18" y="30" width="8" height="6" rx="2" fill="#e63946"/>
  <rect x="74" y="30" width="8" height="6" rx="2" fill="#e63946"/>

  <!-- feet -->
  <rect x="28" y="82" width="10" height="10" rx="3" fill="#f4a300"/>
  <rect x="62" y="82" width="10" height="10" rx="3" fill="#f4a300"/>

  <!-- clock body -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="54" r="32" fill="#ff6b81"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="54" r="26" fill="#ffeaed"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="54" r="24" fill="#fff7f8"/>

  <!-- clock face rim -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="54" r="23" fill="none" stroke="#ff6b81" stroke-width="2"/>

  <!-- hour markers -->
  <g fill="#ff6b81">
    <rect x="49" y="32" width="2" height="6" rx="1"/>
    <rect x="49" y="70" width="2" height="6" rx="1"/>
    <rect x="28" y="53" width="6" height="2" rx="1"/>
    <rect x="66" y="53" width="6" height="2" rx="1"/>
    <rect x="35" y="37" width="2" height="4" rx="1" transform="rotate(-45 36 39)"/>
    <rect x="63" y="37" width="2" height="4" rx="1" transform="rotate(45 64 39)"/>
    <rect x="35" y="67" width="2" height="4" rx="1" transform="rotate(45 36 69)"/>
    <rect x="63" y="67" width="2" height="4" rx="1" transform="rotate(-45 64 69)"/>
  </g>

  <!-- hands -->
  <rect x="49" y="38" width="2.5" height="16" rx="1.2" fill="#e63946"/>
  <rect x="50" y="49" width="14" height="2.5" rx="1.2" fill="#e63946"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="54" r="3.2" fill="#e63946"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="54" r="1.4" fill="#ffd166"/>

  <!-- center cap highlight -->
  <circle cx="49" cy="53" r="0.8" fill="#fff"/>

  <!-- clock body shine -->
  <ellipse cx="38" cy="38" rx="4" ry="2.5" fill="#ffb3c1" opacity="0.8"/>

  <!-- top button -->
  <rect x="46" y="20" width="8" height="5" rx="2" fill="#e63946"/>
</svg>
